tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: Search the public WIA Music catalog of original K-pop / K-trot / K-ballad songs (each sold as a 1-of-1 bundle with sheet music). tools.name: get_song
tools.description: Get full public details of one WIA Music catalog song by slug (key, BPM, formats, links). Read-only; purchase only on the website. (WIA Music 곡 상세 조회.)

tools.name: get_song_lineage
tools.description: Public version tree of a WIA Music song: the original and any derived versions with their receipt-verification links, plus public release records. Contains no buyer or personal data. (곡 계보: 원본·파생 버전·발매 기록. 개인정보 없음.)

tools.name: list_catalog_facets
tools.description: List the current WIA Music catalog facets: genres, musical keys, vocal types, languages and total song count. Useful before calling search_songs. (카탈로그 장르·키·언어 목록.)

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_catalog_facets" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the current WIA Music catalog facets: genres, musical keys, vocal types, languages and total song count. Useful before calling search_songs. (카탈로그 장르·키·언어 …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
